title: Deployment Node Artefact (v1.1.0)
description: Where a service runs: a cloud account and region, a runtime such as Cloud Run or Lambda, a virtual machine, a hosting service, a device (ArchiMate node, C4 deployment node). It carries the properties that matter to operating what it hosts: the account, the region, the runtime, the scaling model and the identity the services run as. The same service on two nodes differs by node properties, not service properties.

account.description: The cloud account, subscription or project the node lives in.

region.description: The region, or location for a device or an on-premises node.

runtime.description: The runtime the node provides, in the provider's words, e.g. Cloud Run, AWS Lambda, GKE, Compute Engine e2-standard-4.

scaling_model.description: How the node's capacity follows load.

run_as.description: The identity the hosted services run as: a service account, an IAM role, a managed identity.

parent.description: The node this one is nested in, e.g. a container runtime inside a virtual machine.

hosts.description: The services deployed to the node, by slug. The inverse of deployed_to on the service.

hosts_stores.description: The stores hosted on the node. The inverse of hosted_on on the store.
